notes.title: JARS is a new take on Tower Defense with puzzles and a Gothic style
notes.notes:
The first PC release from Mousetrap Games is JARS, a blending of a Tower Defense game with puzzles to solve and a pretty great looking gothic style.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/10/jars-is-a-new-take-on-tower-defense-with-puzzles-and-a-gothic-style

notes.title: Steam Next Fest - JARS Demo&Stream
notes.notes:
So happy to be participating in this year’s Steam Next festival! A demo of our point and click adventure and tower defence hybrid - JARS will be playable. There’s plenty of puzzles to solve while uncovering the secrets of the family basement, but watch out for mother, she’s always on the prowl! We’ll be streaming the devs playing the game, we hope you’ll try the game with us and enjoy your time with it!
